statement: At Linux v7.4-rc2 the Switch 2 Pro driver matches HID_USB_DEVICE but no Switch 2 Bluetooth Pro HID match; its probe requires a real USB HID transport and Kconfig states Switch 2 controllers currently support USB only. In the pinned SDL Switch 2 driver the Bluetooth initialization branch explicitly returns an unsupported error. This documents these consumer revisions, not the absence of a physical Bluetooth radio or any future implementation.

applicability.scope: Inspected Linux and SDL Bluetooth support boundary
